cases.prompt: An approved plan asks for one implementation slice. Which skill owns it?
expectations: Consume the approved handoff directly.
Do not create an orchestrator loop.

cases.prompt: Use /goal to ship an approved import plan and preserve long-lived goal status.
expectations: Goal owns lifecycle state.
Executor owns one verified implementation slice.

cases.prompt: A broad feature spans auth, API, migrations, and UI; decide whether to split it before implementation.
expectations: Create trunk-safe PR slices.
Use atomicity assessment for an already mixed diff.

cases.prompt: The approved PR slices have independent owners and worktrees. Plan safe simultaneous work.
expectations: Specify ownership and dependencies.
Do not use decomposition merely because agents are parallel.

cases.prompt: Update the explicitly named API guide, then assess whether newly discovered docs are stale.
expectations: The named guide is directly approved.
Request approval before broad discovered-document expansion.

cases.prompt: Scan registry.example.com/payments:4.2 for CVEs; do not audit source code.
expectations: Route directly to read-only image scanning.
Do not convert an image-CVE request into source security review.

cases.prompt: Use $pr-review for the current authentication PR and include security review.
expectations: Keep pr-review as the single public entrypoint.
Invoke complete diff security as a companion when available.

cases.prompt: Scan registry.example.com/payments:4.2 for image CVEs only.
expectations: Use the image scanner.
Do not activate PR review for an image-only request.

cases.prompt: Only assess whether this existing diff is atomic enough for one PR.
expectations: Use the atomicity assessment skill.
Do not substitute general PR review.

cases.prompt: Use $pr-review on this substantial payment API and idempotency change. Review only.
expectations: Keep pr-review as the public entrypoint.
Automatically add Rubber Duck because the change affects a public payment interface and persisted behavior.
Do not add SPAR without an explicit request.

cases.prompt: Use $pr-review on this cache design and explicitly include $spar to challenge its assumptions.
expectations: Keep pr-review as the public entrypoint.
Run SPAR because the user explicitly requested it.
Keep SPAR challenge output subject to primary confirmation.

cases.prompt: Use $pr-review on this one-line internal label helper change. Review only.
expectations: Run the ordinary applicable review.
Do not add Rubber Duck solely because a review was requested.
Do not add SPAR without an explicit request.

cases.prompt: Use $pr-review on this substantial public API migration, but exclude Rubber Duck. Review only.
expectations: Honor the explicit Rubber Duck exclusion.
Complete ordinary review without silently replacing the excluded challenge.
Do not add SPAR without an explicit request.
